title: _RUN_DELETE_CASCADE_MODELS must mirror SqlRun's ORM delete cascade relationships
answers: I added a new table referencing runs, what do I change for hard delete
new child table not removed when gc deletes a run
which tables are deleted when a run is hard deleted
keep hard delete in sync with run relationships
body:
Invariant: The explicit child-model tuple _RUN_DELETE_CASCADE_MODELS (SqlMetric, SqlLatestMetric, SqlParam, SqlTag) must equal the set of SqlRun relationships configured with a 'delete' cascade. The bulk path in _hard_delete_run does not get ORM cascades, so any model left out is orphaned when a run is hard-deleted.
Enforcement: mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:_hard_delete_run iterates the tuple; tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_runs.py:test_run_delete_cascade_models_match_orm_relationships compares the tuple to sqlalchemy.inspect(SqlRun).relationships filtered by 'delete' in cascade.
What breaks if skipped: A new run-scoped table added with a cascade relationship but missing from the tuple leaves rows behind after mlflow gc, and the ratchet test fails only if it is run.
Constraints: When adding or removing a cascade on SqlRun, update the tuple in the same change. Fix the tuple rather than editing the test to match a drifted tuple. Relationships without a delete cascade are not in the tuple.
Applies: Any change to SqlRun relationships, run-scoped ORM models, or _hard_delete_run.

says: Garbage collection leaves orphaned child records in the database after hard deleting experiment runs.
Deleting runs permanently does not remove records from newly added run-related database tables.
Ensure the cleanup tool removes all associated metrics, parameters, and tags during run deletion.
Prevent orphaned database records when purging deleted experiment runs through the garbage collection command.
Cascade delete all dependent child records whenever an experiment run is permanently erased.
search: Mirroring SqlRun ORM delete cascade relationships in the _RUN_DELETE_CASCADE_MODELS tuple for bulk hard deletes. The explicit tuple (SqlMetric, SqlLatestMetric, SqlParam, SqlTag) in mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py is iterated by _hard_delete_run because bulk deletion bypasses ORM cascades, preventing orphaned rows during mlflow gc. Enforced by tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_runs.py:test_run_delete_cascade_models_match_orm_relationships; changes to SqlRun cascade relationships require updating the tuple directly rather than modifying the test.
